facts.text: I want to create a spreadsheet to track my sales and expenses for my small business.
I sold homemade jams and candles at the Downtown Farmers Market on Saturday, March 18th.
I sold 12 jars of strawberry jam on March 18th.
I want to use Google Sheets Templates because I am already familiar with Google Drive.
I want my sales tracker to distinguish between different products, like my jams and candles.
I sold 8 candles on March 18th in addition to the 12 jars of strawberry jam.
I want to create a separate table to track my expenses, including the cost of ingredients and supplies.
I want to add a column to track the vendor or supplier for my expenses.
I want to create a separate table to track my inventory levels.
